one-ntp.scope: Prospective bounded continuation pilot. First actual update belongs to this registered pilot and counts even on failure. Further updates require independent mixed-global-gradient/optimizer integration pass. Natural NTP remains present;ordered answers and EOS are separately normalized/counted. Each role retains its own qualified NTP foundation,with the same original random initializer and fresh adaptation optimizers. Historical source exposures differ and are fully charged;no new from-scratch confirmation. Native nominal matrices are not chip-time equivalence.
